name: Collaborative Camouflaged Object Detection Dataset
description: A large-scale dataset and benchmark for assessing models' ability to detect camouflaged objects in diverse imagery and collaborative settings.
reputation: Recognized within the computer-vision community studying camouflaged object detection; cited and used in recent COD papers.
notes: Non-LLM, vision-only benchmark; annotations can be noisy and class-imbalanced, and performance varies by scene type—risk of dataset bias across object types and backgrounds.
